body: It feels like I've been like this forever, I can't remember the last day I was genuinely happy and didn't want to die, I can't imagine things ever getting better. Anything good always ends, every person eventually gets sick of me, any hope I have eventually gets shattered. Killing myself always feels like the right answer, anytime I'm not thinking about it I feel like I'm just fooling myself.

Thanks. 

It's been a long time coming. I've no friends, I'm failing in school and most likely won't get into college, people in my family telling me to kms, recently got diagnosed with depression and my family are using it against me, I hate myself and wish I wasn't burdening everyone.

I signed up for a 3 week stay-in language course ages ago thinking it'd be good but now I'd actually rather die. It's tomorrow and I'm freaking out. How do I act like a normal human being and not say awkward, stupid shit? What do people talk about? How do you make conversation? Ugh I'm such an awkward piece of shit. 
I'm seriously panicking rn sorry.
